registration.method: Shared full-canvas transform for the whole three-stalk object; all component positions retained. Never center separate stalk bounds or crop each stem independently.

palette.neutral_preview: Equal RGB; grayscale only, including all growth regions. Native preview receives separate w/g tint; no green is baked into primary albedo.

supported_states: One declared fixed map view. No random builder or native connected variants are present in the inspected object/Plant definitions.
native_behavior: Preserve layer3, source visibility, inherited non-solid physics and occluding=true; authored gaps do not alter occlusion. Damage/spring/plant exceptions stay native.
